Support Oathbound for CoVs, goes TTW or Feast from Afar. 

DPS Oathbound goes TTB or Dreams of Medicine.

Composition wise as Support, he works but is not BiS with Mouch, Dore, Sorel. Mouch wants Helpt thou, and Dore wants Leigh or/and Clem, and Sorel wants Thais. Both Dore and Sorel love Pickman too. 

As DPS, he can is often ran with Hameln or/and S tier Supports/Survivability; Characters like Arachne/Castor/Horla/Clem. 

As Support, he can also just be thrown in for Primordial Chaos Realm, but lots of teams hate the Realm. So some people just make DPS and that solves that. As DPS though, he is *very* mid or lower and needs AA. 

If you are early game, you can can slap him on as a Stat stick or DPS, but oftentimes there are better choices.

24 teams are characterized largely by their reliance on sustain tools and keyflare. 24 is your DPS and your source of Vul, and your main goal is to get her Rouse into play ASAP. 
A team with Ramona, Lily, Doll fills most of those shoes, because Ramona can help pull the card you need the most atm into your hand while still feeding Keyflare from holding Life Drain, and Queen's Sword can also help with a little extra temp Realm Mastery in a pinch.
Lily is your main defender with her fat shield/heal.
Doll can fill in for the leftover space because she can still hold Unstained Chronicles Covenant (i admittedly don't remember if you have access to that at whatever rank you're at?) to supplement keyflare generation, provide extra Weak, shield, Aliemus battery, and heal to round out your sustain.
For Posse, I would actually suggest Tiny Wish over 24's posse because of the boss's aforementioned buff removal
